patients.label: Case 2

Discussion attributes the voriconazole withdrawal to drug-induced hepatitis in all three cases (conflicts with Case 1 only) and describes Case 2 as showing high mortality risk with immunosuppression from poorly controlled diabetes; immunosuppression is the authors' interpretation and is not recorded as a diagnosis.

Table 1 serum and BAL galactomannan cells are dashes for Case 2 (not interpreted as negative or not performed). Units for hemoglobin and CRP are printed as mg/dl and mg/dL and retained verbatim; Table 1 has no stated sample time.

Candida albicans (sputum) and Pseudomonas species (bronchial wash) are documented isolates; the authors call this polymicrobial involvement, but separate invasive candidiasis or Pseudomonas pneumonia is not diagnosed.
